sample_unit: operational radiology report impressions (postdeployment); 200 validation impressions

links.outcome: GPT-4o versus baseline Clinical Longformer on PE extraction performance, same validation set
links.effect: GPT-4o outperformed Clinical Longformer in 2 metrics: sensitivity 1.0 (P<.001) and F1-score 0.975 (95% CI 0.9495-0.9947; P<.001) on validation dataset.
links.quote: GPT-4o outperformed the Clinical Longformer in 2 of the metrics, achieving a sensitivity of 1.0 (95% CI 1.0-1.0; Wilcoxon test, P<.001) and an F1-score of 0.975 (95% CI 0.9495-0.9947; Wilcoxon test, P<.001) across the validation dataset.

links.outcome: Postdeployment performance of GPT-4o on operational records against reference labels
links.effect: On 200 operational records, sensitivity 1.0 (95% CI 1.0-1.0), specificity 0.94 (95% CI 0.8913-0.9804), F1 0.97 (95% CI 0.9479-0.9908).
links.quote: Postdeployment evaluations also showed strong performance of the deployed GPT-4o model with a sensitivity of 1.0 (95% CI 1.0-1.0), a specificity of 0.94 (95% CI 0.8913-0.9804), and an F1-score of 0.97 (95% CI 0.9479-0.9908).

screen.reason: The study evaluates GPT-4o versus Clinical Longformer for extracting pulmonary embolism diagnoses from radiology reports, including postdeployment evaluation on 200 operational records. However, it tests model performance rather than evaluating a specific deployment practice or guardrail.
